about: Tables ios-submit-check matches against. All were written from memory during this work, with no access to Apple's documentation, so every entry is unverified and the script prints that. Apple's App Store Connect help and the privacy manifest documentation are the source. To verify an entry: read the source, correct it, set checked to that day and verified to true.

screenshot_sizes.unit: pixels, portrait; landscape is the same pair swapped
screenshot_sizes.source: memory of App Store Connect screenshot specifications; not read from Apple in this work

usage_keys.unit: source symbol -> purpose-string keys; one of the listed keys must be present and filled
usage_keys.source: memory of Apple's Info.plist key reference; not read from Apple in this work

required_reason_apis.unit: privacy manifest category -> source text that suggests the API is used; text matching over-reports
required_reason_apis.source: memory of Apple's required-reason API list; not read from Apple in this work
